consensus_summary: Fans generally enjoyed the outdoor setting and the overall performance, particularly praising the first set. However, many noted that while it was a solid show, it didn't quite reach the heights of other performances from the same tour.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 12 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans appreciated the performance and venue, several reviews indicated it was not among the best shows of the year, leading to a slightly positive sentiment adjustment.
